url.description: http:// or https:// with a host. Only the scheme, host and port are used.

verifyTls.description: False accepts any certificate; it is still reported.

timeoutMs.description: For the connect and for each read.

network.description: The proxy and client certificates, set by the desktop shell exactly as for http.send; the renderer's copy is discarded.

net.probe.result.description: What a separate connection found, stage by stage. Not part of any exchange's timing. A stage that did not run is absent; a failure is reported here, not as an RPC error.

connectedTo.description: host:port the TCP connection went to: the origin, or the proxy when there is one.

tunnelMs.description: The proxy's answer to CONNECT: HTTPS through a proxy only.

alpn.description: h2 or http/1.1, when the server chose.

verified.description: True only when the certificate was checked and accepted.

certificate.description: The server's leaf certificate, reported even when it was not trusted.
